paragraphs: Theravance Biopharma, Inc. ("we," "our," "Theravance Biopharma" or the "Company") is a biopharmaceutical company primarily focused on the development and commercialization of medicines. Our focus is to deliver medicines that make a difference® in people's lives.

In pursuit of our purpose, we leverage decades of expertise, which has led to the development of the United States ("US") Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") approved YUPELRI® (revefenacin) inhalation solution indicated for the maintenance treatment of patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease ("COPD").
Ampreloxetine Phase 3 Clinical Study Top-line Results

On March 3, 2026, we announced that our ampreloxetine Phase 3 clinical study (CYPRESS) in development for the treatment of symptomatic neurogenic orthostatic hypotension in patients with multiple system atrophy did not meet its primary endpoint in the Orthostatic Hypotension Symptom Assessment composite score. As a result of this outcome, we have decided to wind down the ampreloxetine program.

In connection with the CYPRESS study results, the Strategic Review Committee of our Board of Directors (the "Committee") is accelerating its ongoing review of alternatives to maximize value for shareholders. Since its formation in 2024, the Committee has been working on an ongoing basis with Lazard, its independent financial advisor, to evaluate opportunities available to the Company, including under multiple potential outcomes for the CYPRESS study. Building upon this work, the Committee will act with urgency to evaluate a broad range of value maximizing and tax efficient alternatives, including but not limited to a sale of the Company. There can be no assurance that the Committee's strategic review process will result in any transaction. We do not intend to disclose further developments on this review process unless and until it determines that such disclosure is appropriate or necessary. As we proceed with the orderly wind down of the ampreloxetine program, we will complete additional analyses of the CYPRESS dataset and Phase 3 program, in consultation with external experts, to assess whether the data merits further regulatory discussion. This assessment is intended to provide the Committee with additional clarity regarding any remaining value in ampreloxetine for our shareholders. There can be no assurance that any additional regulatory engagement will occur.

While the Committee accelerates its review, we are implementing an organizational restructuring (the "Restructuring") to streamline costs and align our resources with our commercial focus on YUPELRI. The Restructuring will involve winding down our R&D function and significantly reducing our G&A function. The Restructuring is expected to reduce operating expenses by approximately 60%, relative to 2025 operating expenses of $111.1 million. The full run-rate cost savings of approximately $70 million are expected to be realized beginning in the third quarter of 2026.

In 2025, YUPELRI experienced net sales growth and reached launch-to-date highs in annual net sales and brand profitability. Through the combined commercialization efforts with our partner Viatris Inc., total YUPELRI net sales increased by 12% to $266.6 million in 2025 compared to 2024. Customer demand grew 7% in 2025 compared to 2024. In addition, in January 2026, we received a $25.0 million milestone payment for the achievement of $250.0 million in US net sales in 2025.

In June 2025, we sold our remaining royalty interest in the global net sales of TRELEGY to GSK plc for $225.0 million while retaining our right to receive up to $150.0 million in remaining potential milestone payments from Royalty Pharma Investments. The sales transaction represented the first outcome of the ongoing efforts of the Committee to assess all strategic alternatives available to us to unlock shareholder value.
Achievement of $50.0 Million TRELEGY® Royalty Milestone Payment for 2025

In February 2026, we received a $50.0 million maximum milestone payment from Royalty Pharma Investments associated with the achievement of certain minimum royalty payments related to 2025 TRELEGY global net sales. As of December 31, 2025, we are eligible to receive up to $100.0 million in remaining milestone payments related to TRELEGY's 2026 global net sales. TRELEGY's 2025 global net sales of $3.91 billion would exceed the thresholds required to achieve the $100.0 million milestone in 2026 (based on $3.51 billion of global net sales).

YUPELRI (revefenacin) inhalation solution is a once-daily, nebulized long-acting muscarinic antagonist ("LAMA") approved for the maintenance treatment of COPD in the US. LAMAs are recognized by international COPD treatment guidelines as a cornerstone of maintenance therapy for COPD, regardless of severity of disease. Our market research indicates there is an enduring population of COPD patients in the US that either need or prefer nebulized delivery for maintenance therapy. The stability of revefenacin in both metered dose inhaler and dry powder inhaler ("MDI/DPI") formulations suggests that revefenacin could also serve as a foundation for novel handheld combination products.

We co-developed YUPELRI with our collaboration partner, Viatris Inc. ("Viatris"). Under the terms of the Viatris Development and Commercialization Agreement (the "Viatris Agreement"), we led the US Phase 3 development program for YUPELRI in COPD, and Viatris was responsible for reimbursement of our costs related to the registrational program up until the approval of the first new drug application, after which costs were shared. YUPELRI was approved by the FDA for the maintenance treatment of patients with COPD in November 2018. In the US, Viatris is leading the commercialization of YUPELRI, and we co-promote the product under a profit and loss sharing arrangement (65% to Viatris; 35% to us). Outside the US (excluding China and adjacent territories), Viatris is responsible for development and commercialization and will pay us a tiered royalty on net sales at percentage royalty rates ranging from low double-digits to mid-teens. We retain worldwide rights to revefenacin delivered through other dosage forms, such as a MDI/DPI.

Under the terms of the Viatris Agreement, as amended, we received a $25.0 million milestone payment for the achievement of $250.0 million in net sales in 2025. As of December 31, 2025, we were eligible to receive from Viatris potential global sales and regulatory milestone payments (excluding China and adjacent territories) of up to $180.0 million in the aggregate with $135.0 million associated with YUPELRI monotherapy and $45.0 million associated with future potential combination products. Of the $135.0 million associated with monotherapy, $10.0 million relates to regulatory actions in the EU and $125.0 million relates to sales milestones based on achieving certain levels of annual aggregate US net sales as follows:
$500.0 million $50.0 million $750.0 million $75.0 million

headings: Summary of Principal Risks Associated with Theravance Biopharma's Business

If YUPELRI's acceptance by physicians, patients, third-party payors, or the medical community in general does not continue to grow, we may not receive significant additional revenues from sales of this product.
In collaboration with Viatris, we are responsible for marketing and sales of YUPELRI in the US, which subjects us to certain risks.

If our partners do not satisfy their obligations under our agreements with them, or if they terminate our partnerships with us, we may not be able to develop or commercialize our partnered products as planned.
We may not sustain profitability from our operations.
There is a single source of supply for YUPELRI, and our business will be harmed if manufacturers are not able to satisfy demand and alternative sources are not available.

If we are unable to enter into future collaboration arrangements or if any such collaborations are unsuccessful, we may be unable to fully develop and commercialize products and our business will be adversely affected.

If there are any adverse developments or perceived adverse developments with respect to TRELEGY, we may not receive Milestone Payments, which would harm our business and could cause the price of our securities to fall.
We do not control the commercialization of TRELEGY; accordingly, our receipt of Milestone Payments will depend on, among other factors, GSK's ability to further commercialize TRELEGY.
Our business and operations would suffer in the event of significant disruptions of information technology systems or security breaches.
Global economic, political, and social conditions may harm our ability to do business, increase our costs and negatively affect our stock price.
We may be treated as a US corporation for US federal income tax purposes.
Future tax reform, including changes in tax rates and imposition of new taxes, could impact our results of operations and financial condition.
Taxing authorities may challenge our structure and transfer pricing arrangements.
We were a passive foreign investment company, or "PFIC," for 2014, but we were not a PFIC from 2015 through 2025, and we do not expect to be a PFIC for the foreseeable future.
If we are unable to maintain effective internal controls, our business, financial position, and results of operations could be adversely affected.
If sufficient capital is not available, we may have to further curtail operations or we could be forced to sell or license assets on terms that may not be favorable to us.
paragraphs: The risks described below and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and in our other public filings with the SEC are not the only risks facing us. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial also may materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and/or operating results.

● If YUPELRI's acceptance by physicians, patients, third-party payors, or the medical community in general does not continue to grow, we may not receive significant additional revenues from sales of this product;
● In collaboration with Viatris, we are responsible for marketing and sales of YUPELRI in the US, which subjects us to certain risks;

● If our partners do not satisfy their obligations under our agreements with them, or if they terminate our partnerships with us, we may not be able to develop or commercialize our partnered products as planned;

● We face substantial competition from companies with more resources and experience than we have, which may result in others discovering, developing, receiving approval for or commercializing products more successfully than we do;

● Our strategic review process may not result in an executed or consummated transaction or other strategic alternative, and the process of reviewing strategic alternatives or its conclusion could adversely affect our business and our shareholders;

paragraphs: Theravance Biopharma, Inc. ("we," "our," "Theravance Biopharma" or the "Company") 為一間主要從事藥物開發與商業化之生物科技公司。我們的目標是提供能對人們生活產生影響®之藥物。
為達成我們的宗旨，我們運用數十年的專業經驗，已開發出美國 ("US") 食品藥物管理局 (the "FDA") 批准之 YUPELRI® (revefenacin) 吸入溶液，用於慢性阻塞性肺病 ("COPD") 患者之維持治療。
Ampreloxetine 第三階段臨牀試驗初步結果
於 2026 年 3 月 3 日，我們宣佈，我們用以開發用以治療多發性系統萎縮患者之症狀性神經源性體位性低血壓之 ampreloxetine 第三階段臨牀試驗 (CYPRESS) 未達成其主要評估指標，即站起來後低血壓症狀評估組合分數。此結果導致我們決定逐步終止 ampreloxetine 研發計畫。

關於 CYPRESS 試驗結果，我們董事會之戰略評估委員會 (the "Committee") 正加速進行其持續進行之評估，以最大化對股東之價值。自 2024 年成立以來，該委員會已持續與其獨立財務顧問 Lazard 合作，評估對本公司可提供的機會，包括多種 CYPRESS 試驗可能結果之情境。基於此工作，該委員會將以緊迫態度評估廣泛之價值最大化且稅務效率高的替代方案，包括但不限於出售本公司。無法保證該委員會之戰略評估程序會導致任何交易。除非該委員會認為披露為適當或必要，否則我們不預計進一步披露此評估程序之進展。在有序終止 ampreloxetine 研發計畫的同時，我們將與外部專家合作，完成對 CYPRESS 資料集及第三階段計畫之進一步分析，以評估資料是否值得進一步向監管機構討論。此評估旨在為該委員會提供額外明確資訊，以瞭解 ampreloxetine 對股東可能殘餘之價值。無法保證會有任何額外之監管互動發生。
雖然該委員會加速進行評估，我們正在進行組織重整 (the "Restructuring")，以削減成本並使資源與我們對 YUPELRI 之商業重點對齊。此重整將涉及終止我們之研發部門，並大幅削減我們之營運及行政部門。此重整預期將使營運費用減少約 60%，相較於 2025 年營運費用為 111.1 百萬美元。預計總共約 70 百萬美元之成本節省將於 2026 年第三季開始實現。

2025 年，YUPELRI 達成淨銷售額成長，並創下上市至今之年度淨銷售額與品牌獲利之新高。透過與我們之合作夥伴 Viatris Inc. 之合作商業化努力，2025 年總 YUPELRI 淨銷售額較 2024 年成長 12%，達 266.6 百萬美元。2025 年客戶需求較 2024 年成長 7%。此外，於 2026 年 1 月，我們收到 25.0 百萬美元之里程碑付款，因達成 2025 年美國淨銷售額達 250.0 百萬美元。
於 2025 年 6 月，我們將我們在全球淨銷售額之 TRELEGY 未實現特許權利益出售給 GSK plc，獲取 225.0 百萬美元，同時保留我們可獲得最多 150.0 百萬美元之剩餘潛在里程碑付款之權利，此交易為該委員會持續評估所有可提供之戰略替代方案以釋放股東價值之持續努力之第一個成果。
達成 2025 年 TRELEGY® 製藥特許權金里程碑付款 50.0 百萬美元

2026 年 2 月，我們從 Royalty Pharma Investments 收到與達成 2025 年 TRELEGY 全球淨銷售額相關最低特許權金支付額對應的 50.0 百萬美元最高里程碑付款。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們有資格獲得與 TRELEGY 2026 年全球淨銷售額相關的最高 100.0 百萬美元剩餘里程碑付款。TRELEGY 2025 年全球淨銷售額為 3.91 十億美元，將超過達成 2026 年 100.0 百萬美元里程碑所需的門檻（基於 3.51 十億美元的全球淨銷售額）。

YUPELRI（revefenacin）吸入溶液為每日一次、經霧化器使用的長效抗膽鹼藥物（"LAMA"），已核准用於美國慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）患者的維持治療。國際 COPD 治療指引將 LAMA 認可為 COPD 維持治療的基石，不論疾病嚴重程度如何。我們的市場研究顯示，美國仍有持續的 COPD 患者需要或偏好經霧化器使用的給藥方式進行維持治療。revefenacin 在計量吸入器與乾粉吸入器（"MDI/DPI"）製劑中的穩定性，顯示其可能也成為新型手持組合產品的基礎。

我們與合作夥伴 Viatris Inc.（"Viatris"）共同開發 YUPELRI。根據 Viatris 開發與商業化協議（"Viatris 協議"），我們領導 YUPELRI 在 COPD 的美國第三期臨牀試驗計畫，而 Viatris 負責補償我們在註冊計畫相關成本，直至第一個新藥申請獲准，之後成本由雙方共同承擔。YUPELRI 於 2018 年 11 月獲美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准用於 COPD 患者的維持治療。在美國，Viatris 正領導 YUPELRI 的商業化，我們則根據獲利與損失分擔協議（Viatris 為 65%；我們為 35%）共同推廣該產品。在美國以外的地區（不含中國及鄰近地區），Viatris 負責開發與商業化，並將根據淨銷售額支付我們不同層級的特許權金，特許權金率為低雙位數至中位數。我們保留透過其他劑型（如 MDI/DPI）給藥的 revefenacin 全球權利。

根據 Viatris 協議（經修正後）的條款，我們因達成 2025 年 250.0 百萬美元淨銷售額而收到 25.0 百萬美元里程碑付款。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們有資格從 Viatris 收到（不含中國及鄰近地區）潛在全球銷售與法規里程碑付款，總計最高達 180.0 百萬美元，其中 135.0 百萬美元與 YUPELRI 單獨使用有關，45.0 百萬美元與未來潛在組合產品有關。在與單獨使用相關的 135.0 百萬美元中，10.0 百萬美元與歐盟的法規行動有關，125.0 百萬美元與達成特定年度美國淨銷售額的銷售里程碑有關，如下：
500.0 百萬美元 50.0 百萬美元 750.0 百萬美元 75.0 百萬美元

paragraphs: 本公司管理層討論與分析（"MD&A"）旨在協助讀者瞭解本公司營運成果，以及流動性及資本資源。此外，此段落亦說明管理層認為屬"關鍵會計政策與會計估計"的會計政策與估計。此MD&A應與本年度10-K表報表所附之合併財務報表及附註一併閱讀。本年度10-K表報表中所包含之資訊，包括本公司業務計畫與策略、營運費用及合作協議下未來應支付金額等資訊，包含根據1933年證券法（"證券法"）第27A條款及1934年證券交易法（"證券交易法"）第21E條款所定義之預測性陳述。這些陳述係基於目前預期，並涉及風險與不確定性。請參閱上文第一部分第1A項所載之"風險因素"段落，以瞭解可能導致實際結果與預測性陳述中所述或暗示之結果有重大差異的重要因素。有關預測性陳述之特別說明，請參閱第3頁之"預測性陳述特別說明"段落。
Theravance Biopharma, Inc.（"我們"、"我們的"、"Theravance Biopharma"或"本公司"）為一主要從事藥物開發與商業化之生物科技公司。本公司之目標為提供能對人們生活產生差異®之藥物。
為實現本公司之宗旨，我們運用數十年之專業經驗，已開發出美國（"美國"）食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）核准之YUPELRI®（revefenacin）吸入溶液，用於慢性阻塞性肺病（"COPD"）患者之維持治療。
Ampreloxetine 第三期臨牀試驗初步結果
2026年3月3日，本公司宣佈，我們針對治療多發性系統萎縮患者症狀性神經源性體位性低血壓的ampreloxetine第三期臨牀試驗（CYPRESS）未達成其主要評估指標，即體位性低血壓症狀評估複合指數。基於此結果，本公司已決定逐步終止ampreloxetine計畫。

配合CYPRESS試驗結果，本公司董事會戰略審查委員會（"委員會"）正在加速進行持續進行的審查，以最大化對股東的價值。自2024年成立以來，委員會已持續與其獨立財務顧問Lazard合作，評估對本公司可提供的機會，包括多種CYPRESS試驗可能結果的情況。基於此工作，委員會將以緊迫的態度評估廣泛的價值最大化且稅務效率高的替代方案，包括但不限於出售本公司。無法保證委員會的戰略審查程序會導致任何交易。除非委員會認為有必要或適當，否則本公司不會進一步披露此審查程序的進展。在有序終止ampreloxetine計畫的同時，本公司將在與外部專家協議下，完成對CYPRESS數據集及第三期計畫的進一步分析，以評估數據是否值得進一步向監管機構討論。此評估旨在為委員會提供額外的明確資訊，以瞭解ampreloxetine對股東可能殘餘的價值。無法保證會進行任何額外的監管互動。
雖然委員會加速進行審查，本公司正在進行組織重整（"重整"），以簡化成本並使資源與商業重點YUPELRI對齊。重整將涉及終止研發部門，並大幅減少一般及行政部門的規模。重整
預期將使營運費用減少約 60%，相較於 2025 年營運費用為 111.1 百萬美元。預計完整的成本節省效益約為 70 百萬美元，將自 2026 年第三季開始實現。

2025 年，YUPELRI 達成淨銷售額成長，並創下年度淨銷售額與品牌獲利力的歷史新高。透過與我們的夥伴 Viatris Inc. 合作的商業化努力，2025 年 YUPELRI 的淨銷售額較 2024 年成長 12%，達 266.6 百萬美元。2025 年客戶需求較 2024 年成長 7%。此外，2026 年 1 月，我們因達成 2025 年 250.0 百萬美元美國淨銷售額的里程碑，收到 25.0 百萬美元的里程碑付款。
2025 年 6 月，我們以 225.0 百萬美元將 TRELEGY 全球淨銷售額的剩餘版稅權益出售給 GSK plc，同時保留從 Royalty Pharma Investments 收取最多 150.0 百萬美元剩餘潛在里程碑付款之權利。此筆交易代表我們持續評估所有戰略選擇以釋放股東價值的委員會努力的首個成果。
達成 2025 年 TRELEGY® 版稅里程碑付款 50.0 百萬美元
請參閱第 1 項「業務」，自第 4 頁開始，以更完整的內容討論我們的業務。

我們對財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析，係根據我們的合併財務報表，這些財務報表係依照美國通用會計準則（"GAAP"）編製。編製這些財務報表需要我們做出影響收入、費用、資產、負債及其他相關揭露的估計與假設。我們的估計係基於我們的歷史經驗及其他我們認為在當時情況下合理的因素，這些結果成為我們對無法從其他來源顯而易見的資產與負債的攜帶價值做出判斷的基礎。實際結果可能因不同的假設或條件而與這些估計不同。我們認為，以下討論的會計政策與估計對理解我們的營運成果與財務狀況至關重要，因為這些政策與估計涉及管理層的判斷。

headings: 與 Theravance Biopharma 事業相關的主要風險總結
若 YUPELRI 無法持續被醫師、患者、第三方付款者或醫療界接受，我們可能無法從此產品的銷售中獲得顯著額外收入。
與 Viatris 合作，我們負責 YUPELRI 在美國的行銷與銷售，這使我們面臨某些風險。
若我們的合作夥伴無法履行與我們的協議義務，或終止與我們的合作關係，我們可能無法按照原計畫開發或商業化我們的合作產品。
我們可能無法維持來自營運的獲利能力。
YUPELRI 的供應來源為單一來源，若製造商無法滿足需求且無替代來源，將會對我們的業務造成損害。
若我們無法與未來的合作夥伴簽訂合作協議，或任何合作協議未能成功，我們可能無法完全開發與商業化產品，將對我們的業務造成不利影響。
若針對 TRELEGY 發生任何不利發展或被認為有不利發展，我們可能無法收到里程碑付款，這將對我們的業務造成損害，並可能導致我們證券的價格下跌。
我們不控制 TRELEGY 的商業化；因此，我們收到里程碑付款將取決於，除其他因素外，GSK 進一步商業化 TRELEGY 的能力。
若資訊科技系統發生重大中斷或遭遇安全 breach，將對我們的業務與營運造成影響。
全球總體經濟、政治與社會條件可能影響我們的營運能力，增加我們的成本，並對我們的股票價格產生負面影響。
我們可能被視為美國公司，以符合美國聯邦所得稅的規定。
未來的稅制改革，包括稅率變動及新稅種的課徵，可能影響我們的營運結果與財務狀況。
稅務機關可能質疑我們的結構與轉讓定價安排。
我們在 2014 年被視為被動外國投資公司（"PFIC"），但從 2015 年至 2025 年我們並非 PFIC，且我們預期在可預見的未來不會成為 PFIC。
若我們無法維持有效的內部控制，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運結果產生不利影響。

paragraphs: 下列所描述之風險以及本年度報告表 10-K 以及其他公開檔案中所提及之風險，並非唯一可能影響我們之風險。尚有其他未為我們所知或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性，亦可能對我們之業務、財務狀況及/或營運成果造成重大不利影響。
● 若 YUPELRI 產品未能持續獲得醫師、患者、第三方支付者或醫療界之接受度，我們可能無法從該產品之銷售中獲得顯著之額外收入；
● 我們與 Viatris 合作，負責 YUPELRI 在美國之行銷與銷售，此一安排使我們面臨某些風險；
● 若我們之合作夥伴未能履行其根據與我們之協議所應負之義務，或終止與我們之合作關係，我們可能無法依照原計畫開發或商業化我們之合作產品；
● 我們面臨來自擁有更多資源與經驗之公司之重大競爭，這可能導致他人發現、開發、取得核准或成功商業化產品，而我們則無法做到；
● 我們之戰略評估程序可能無法導致執行或完成交易或其他戰略替代方案，且評估戰略替代方案之過程或其結果可能對我們之業務及股東造成不利影響；
